nodes.title: 1.Intro
widgets_values:
In the previous video, a demonstration was provided on upscaling still images using "Make Tile SEGS". 
This video showcases upscaling video using AnimateDiff.

nodes.title: 2. PreviewDetailerHook
widgets_values: Since upscaling videos requires a significant amount of time, the PreviewDetailerHookProvider has been connected to allow monitoring of the intermediate results.

widgets_values_named.text: Since upscaling videos requires a significant amount of time, the PreviewDetailerHookProvider has been connected to allow monitoring of the intermediate results.

nodes.title: 3. Detailer For AnimateDiff
widgets_values:
The upscaling of a typical AnimateDiff video involves upscaling of separate regions. 
Therefore, detailing and pasting processes can be separated, allowing the use of "SEGSDetailer For AnimateDiff".

However, for upscaling using Tile SEGS, as it requires progressive cumulative upscaling, Detailing and Pasting should occur simultaneously using the "Detailer For AnimateDiff" node.

nodes.title: 4. ControlNetApply (SEGS)
widgets_values:
For a more reliable upscale process of Tile SEGS, "ControlNetApply (SEGS)" can be utilized.

Original video batch images can be preprocessed to connect to 'control_image', or 'segs_preprocessor' can be used. 
When using 'segs_preprocessor', the SEGS images are used as control image without a pre-generated control_image.

When using ControlNetApply (SEGS) with AnimateDiff, ComfyUI-ControlNet-Advanced must be installed.
